title: Don't use ENC_NA as encoding for FT_STRING fields

notes.body:
It looks as if it might mostly be "don't combine ENC_NA with ENC_ASCII" - which is correct, as the encoding *is* applicable, as in "it's ASCII", although no *byte order* need be specified.

There might also have been cases where ENC_NA was used *alone*, which is also wrong, as the encoding is obviously applicable, and is presumably ASCII in those cases.
Yes, those are the only 2 cases I've started changing for FT_STRING calls.
